messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — planning the v2 toggle tonight during the change window (00:30 UTC). Intention: flip header gate to opt-v2, keep v1 available via client pin for 48h for older mobile SDKs. Primary goals: 1) avoid regressions for mobile users, 2) validate routing and latency, 3) publish minimal release notes.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for v2-toggle job at 2024-07-15T00:30:00Z. Canary stages: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Autoscale warmup enabled.

ben: confirm who owns monitoring during canary? i can take the first 30m for latency + error spikes. :eyes:

esther: i'll own quality regressions and client-fallback metrics. setting an alert for: error_rate > 0.5% (5m), p50 increase > 200ms (10m), and client_fallback_rate > 0.2%. adding runbook link.

liam: mobile PM flagged older SDKs (<=1.6.0) will need pin. plan: gateway will honor header x-redwood-client-pin: v1 for these users. We'll pin server-side for 48h then re-evaluate.

ben: nice. what's the exact header check we should validate in smoke?

ben: ```
# header check for client pin
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/generate 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'x-redwood-client-version: 1.5.3' 
  -H 'x-redwood-client-pin: v1' 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# expect 200 and response header: x-redwood-route-used: v1
```

esther: copy. i'll include that in the prod smoke checklist. qa-bot, can you run the smoke after canary reaches 10%?

qa-bot: will run automated smoke and functional checks at 10% mark. posting results back here.

sara: canary cadence: wait 10m at 1%, if no alerts then move to 10%. wait 15m at 10% and verify metrics + logs. if green -> 50% (15m), then full. rollback triggers: any alert above thresholds, or manual >2 engineers + oncall signoff.

deploy-bot: canary started: 1% (1739025000).

ben: monitoring dashboards: routes.v2.latency, routes.v2.errors, client.fallback.count, infra.gpu.queue_depth. I'll be on pager for first 45m.

esther: note for release notes — include this short snippet so Support can triage: 
- v2 default routing for new requests; legacy clients will be served v1 when pinned via x-redwood-client-pin.
- Breaking behavior: if clients rely on implicit fallback to v1, they should set x-redwood-client-pin until they upgrade.

liam: i'm posting the deprecation email draft to #announcements after deploy completes. will include upgrade guide for mobile (1.7.0 release).

qa-bot: smoke run @10%: PASS (basic generation, header routing checks). Regression tests: no quality regression detected in seed prompt set.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 10% (1739025800).

ben: seeing a small p95 increase (~120ms) on v2 but within expected. error rate flat. continuing. :thumbsup:

esther: also watching client_fallback_count — currently zero for canary users. good.

sara: reminder: if a client reports an incompatibility, we will pin traffic back to v1 for that client via gateway rule and open a support ticket. escalation path: PM -> Eng oncall -> Backend lead.

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% (1739026500).

ben: no signals for rollback, proceeding to 100% in 20m if stable.

deploy-bot: deploying final stage (100%) now (1739027000). :shipit:

qa-bot: post-deploy quick checks: generation latency p50 unchanged, p95 +90ms, errors unchanged. header routing confirmed for pinned clients.

esther: publishing release notes draft to #eng-docs and support: 
"Release v2: Improved streaming and function-call handling. Default routing moves to v2 for unpinned clients. Legacy clients may continue to hit v1 if pinned via header for 48 hours. Please upgrade SDKs to 1.7.0+ for full compatibility."

sara: final: we'll keep v1 pinned gateway rule for known mobile client segments until 48h expires. after 48h we remove pin and monitor a 24h window before deprecation announcement. thanks everyone. :tada:

deploy-bot: rollout complete (1739027210)."
